newsitem.title: FINLAND: Partek says tractors are core business.
newsitem.headline: Partek says tractors are core business.

text.p: Finnish cargo handling equipment and building materials group Partek Oy Ab considers tractors part of its core business, Partek spokeswoman Kaisa Vikkula said on Thursday.

"Tractors belong to Partek's core business," Vikkula said by telephone when asked to comment on a report in Finnish business newspaper Kauppalehti that some overseas equities analysts had said the tractors were apparently marked for sale.
"I was surprised to read that," Vikkula said. "These are analysts' own assessments of what the company will do in the future." @
Partek is getting into the tractor business as a result of a merger with Finnish state-controled heavy vehicle and tractor maker Sisu Oy, announced in January.
Partek CEO Christoffer Taxell said last month the new Partek would have six core businesses: container handling machines, cargo handling equipment, forest machines, tractors, minerals and insulation.
Based on 1996 results, the merger with Sisu will create a company with annual net sales of 12 billion markka compared to 6.2 billion for Partek alone. @
Sisu's tractors unit had 1996 net sales of 2.6 billion markka, up from 2.4 billion in 1995, and operating income of 98 million markka, down from 115 million a year earlier.
